Stats

HookHorror
A Hook Horror Spore Servant is a reanimated version of a  Hook Horror found in the Act One.

Overview

Hook Horror Spore Servants can be encountered in the Ebonlake Grotto of the Underdark region only. It is a dead mostrosity, reanimated by Myconids through their  Animating Spores ability. Brought back from the dead, this creature implicitly obeys the myconids' sovereign (the colony leader) and defends the colony inhabitants against any threat.

Hook Horror Spore Servant guards the entrance to the Ebonlake Grotto that leads to the Decrepit Village.

Notes

  • While the Hook Horror Spore Servants are obviously a subkind of undead creatures, they inherit all the stats and feats of the living creature they once were. Also, their portrait does not change. Unlike myconids and most other Spore Servants, Hook Horror Spore Servants are not vulnerable to Fire damage.
